summary: Iter 379 — READ-ONLY verification of the seed-script fix (idempotent upserts) + backend no-regression. seed_script_verification.idempotency_review: All three sites use $setOnInsert (never $set) so pre-existing documents are NEVER mutated. Duplicates in the in-memory services list are collapsed by unique_services dict-by-name before bulk_write. ordered=False ensures a single upsert failure would not abort the batch. No path was found that could overwrite an existing document's fields.
